# Third-party crates in the iOS app (dependency set)

Generated 2026-10-06 (slice 12-C) with `cargo metadata --format-version 1 --locked --filter-platform aarch64-apple-ios`, run from `projects/disconect-app/src-tauri`, then walking the resolve graph from the app crate along normal (non-dev, non-build) dependency edges only. This is the dependency set of the iOS app: 318 packages besides the app crate itself, of which one is the product's own `disconect-core` (AGPL-3.0-or-later, path dependency, listed for completeness). Licence expressions are copied verbatim from each crate's manifest (SPDX or the older `/` spelling). The MPL-2.0 crates (cssparser, cssparser-macros, dtoa-short, option-ext, selectors) are file-level copyleft: they can be combined with the AGPL product as long as any change to those crates' own files stays under the MPL (we vendor and patch none of them). Shipping these notices inside the iOS app (an in-app licence screen or bundled text) is booked for I4; this list is the source for it. Updated 2026-10-06 (slice 12-D): `objc2-foundation` 0.3.2 and `objc2` 0.6.4 (both MIT, from their manifests) became direct, iOS-only dependencies of the app crate (the start-up hook `src/ios.rs`); both were already in this set through tauri and wry at the same versions, so the count (318) and the licence table are unchanged, re-checked with the same `cargo metadata` walk. Updated 2026-10-07 (slice 12-F row 5b): `objc2-ui-kit` 0.3.2 (Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT) and `block2` 0.6.2 (MIT) became direct, iOS-only dependencies (the app-switcher cover `src/cover.rs`); both were already in this set through tauri and wry at the same locked versions, so the count (318) and the licence table are unchanged. Build-time-only crates (build scripts, proc macros reached only through build edges) are not part of this set.
